_about: Apollodorus in English: Sir James George Frazer's translation of the Library (Loeb, 1921, 2 vols.), from Perseus TEI (section "perseus", fetched by pipeline/fetch_perseus.py); the file carries Frazer's notes and appendices with the translation. The Loeb prints the Greek facing; the Perseus English file is separate. The TEI markup is Perseus Digital Library's, CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution + share-alike), recorded per file in the report.
